HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Panch- mahabhoot with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   C. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Social and National Festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.
   D. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues for righteousness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues for righteousness.
   B. Use Virtues for righteousness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues for righteousness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Virtues for righteousness has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.
   B. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s.
   D. Say Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. .
   D. Say Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dainik Prarthana and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of integrity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
